question: The SI unit of length is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Meter.**__

__
 
• The SI unit of length is **Meter (m).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__** 

__
 
• **Meter** is the SI unit of Length denoted by (m).
 
• In CGS, the unit of length is **centimetres (cm).**
 
• S.I system (**standard international system**). In this system, the units of mass, length and time are the same, as that of the M.K.S system. However, it is an enlarged system encompassing all fundamental units** **
 
• The full form of the CGS system is the **Centimeter Gram Second system**. In the CGS system, fundamental units are Centimeter, Gram, and second.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **An inch** is a unit of length of Anglo-Saxon origin. The size of an inch is defined as one twelfth of a foot or 2.54 cm
 
• The foot ( pl. feet), standard symbol: ft, is a unit of length in the British imperial and United States customary systems of measurement.
 
• Mile is a unit of distance.
